name: Ore no Dorei ~Hikawa Shizuku
source:
Main character belongs to a powerful family. He gets weary of playing with women, but he meets a girl who shows no interest and vows to make her his possession. All his initiatives are rejected, so he prepares methods to force her love.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-september-2006-pp.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公出身权势显赫的家族。他已经厌倦与女人逢场作戏，却在这时遇见一个对自己毫无兴趣的女孩，于是发誓要将她据为己有。种种追求手段无一奏效后，他开始筹划如何强迫少女爱上自己。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-september-2006-pp.html]vndbreview[/url]]
